thread:
morgan: Quick idea: instead of flipping the whole batcher to microbatch mode during KV storms, try a graded "pressure" mechanism per-tenant to surgically limit noisy tenants.

sam: Good call. How do we compute pressure cheaply?

morgan: Three cheap signals: inflight_tokens, recent_kv_miss_rate, p95_enqueue_ms in 1s bins. Weighted sum -> score.

tara: Keep runtime boundaries clean: ScoreProducer emits (tenant, score) and admission maps score->action. admit(req, hints?) stays optional.

sam: Actions = NOOP | SOFT_SHRINK | FORCE_TINY | DEMOTE_PRIORITY. Sticky per-session for streaming.

morgan: Use state machine per-tenant: OK -> SOFT -> HARD -> RECOVER with hysteresis and backoff to avoid flapping.

tara: Observability: emit batcher.tenant_score, batcher.demoted_tenants, transition events for Console. Also audit on operator overrides. devops-bot: audit-log created at /audit/batcher/overrides.

sam: Start local-only (no external telemetry) behind flag --enable-graded-pressure. Canary rollout plan acknowledged.

morgan: I'll open a small PR with ScoreProducer stub + sim tests. Tune weights from canary telemetry. :thumbsup:
